We do offer a CV database search where we can filter and select CVs for you to approach candidates directly- I have done a quick search this morning based on ‘Technical Sales’ within 30 minutes of Essex- 93 Candidates.
Naturally, not all of these will be relevant candidates, but having had again, a quick perusal I would suspect at least 10% may be viable.
We usually offer this for £199.00+ VAT but I will give you this free of charge IF after 2 weeks you are not getting the desired response. I also have the option to invite candidates to apply, again this is something I can look at once we have monitored the campaign- together.

In addition to all of the above I just want to re-iterate that I am your new account manager, and I genuinely look after my customers- customer is king and that attitude has served me well over the years.

If you do not have a branded advert, it is our agency logo which appears and the ‘my client xyz’ is much more generic. Candidates like to know who they are applying to work for, it can also cut down the likelihood of irrelevant candidates applying.
b)	Lets get some pre-screening questions on so that when candidates click to apply, they have to answer up to 5 questions.
c)	You may also find that (especially with sales roles) candidates will use their own initiative in making direct contact with the client via email, phone or the website in order to progress an application

Hi Stephen,

I really appreciate your time this morning.

First and foremost I would just like to assure you that your previous experience is not typical, and that we can definitely support you with recruitment at AMPCS.

Having worked in Sales myself for over 15 years,  some experience of which includes technical, and high profile clients such as BAE I feel well place to not only manage you account, but to also manage expectations and to develop a positive ongoing relationship with both yourself and the business.

Technical Sales Manager
I have had a quick look at the last advert and the 6 candidates which were flagged as suitable. I agree 100% that 4 of the 6 were definitely NOT suitable, however I can see why the other 2 were marked as potentially suitable:
1.	Ray Mullen
2.	David Wolfarth
I have taken the liberty of attaching these candidate CVs with some highlighting to demonstrate not necessarily that they the ‘right’ candidate, but why they would have been marked as suitable for your review.

As mentioned we do value your business and I am eager for you to continue to work with us, albeit under my remit. 

We do offer a CV database search where we can filter and select CVs for you to approach candidates directly- I have done a quick search this morning based on ‘Technical Sales’ within 30 minutes of Essex- 93 Candidates.
Naturally, not all of these will be relevant candidates, but having had again, a quick perusal I would suspect at least 10% may be viable.
We usually offer this for £199.00+ VAT but I will give you this free of charge IF after 2 weeks you are not getting the desired response. I also have the option to invite candidates to apply, again this is something I can look at once we have monitored the campaign- together.

In addition to all of the above I just want to re-iterate that I am your new account manager, and I genuinely look after my customers- customer is king and that attitude has served me well over the years.

I would really encourage you to run another advertisement campaign, let me show you just how well our adverts can work.

Having looked into it, I am aware that the last campaign was a ‘Premium’ and you wanted to remain anonymous- this is not something I would encourage.
My personal recommendation would be this: Premium Branded Advert – includes CV Library (Sponsored) and also LinkedIn (Sponsored) – These are really good for Sales roles

a)	Company Logo on the advert, and name within the advert- this typically generates up to 30% greater a response. 
If you do not have a branded advert, it is our agency logo which appears and the ‘my client xyz’ is much more generic. Candidates like to know who they are applying to work for, it can also cut down the likelihood of irrelevant candidates applying.
b)	Lets get some pre-screening questions on so that when candidates click to apply, they have to answer up to 5 questions.
c)	You may also find that (especially with sales roles) candidates will use their own initiative in making direct contact with the client via email, phone or the website in order to progress an application
d)	Adjust the salary from £20000 - 25000 per year + - I believe that this is too low – I would like to draw your attention to a quick search I did on Total Jobs this morning- within 30 miles of Essex 

With all of the above being said, I would also like to offer you a 5% discount: £499 less 5% discount= £474.05+ VAT
Including the full price advert, candidate database search and the invite to apply this would usually cost £698.00 = VAT

I could have offered you our Standard £299 with the 5% discount but I don’t think this would be right for you. My job is not to ‘sell’ you an advert, I am here to consult you on the best way to advertise, and attract the RIGHT candidates to fill your vacancies.

Please come back to me with your thoughts- happy for you to give me a call to talk through the above.
